t: ff.84 CES: the tech craft fair
st: Rabbits and molluscs: the future of screens and sensors?

sec.p: 05535 0705 (if you know what I mean). We all typed this number on a calculator's LCD. Liquid crystal displays are also behind Esselunga's ever more astronomical prices.
It's no coincidence that screens ruled CES, since they're our interface to the digital world (🎼 ff.64 The metaphysics of the metaverse).

sec.t: ff.84.3 Did someone say Artificial Intelligence?
sec.p: Transformers are fortissimo (⚠️ff.83.2 Pay attention!). But they were a niche until OpenAI came up with an interface accessible to the public.
Physical objects will be more and more online: by 2030 the Internet of Things will count 30 billion connections, 3x today's figure.
